北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，体感 32℃。记得防晒补水，注意防暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and hot, feels like 32°C. Remember sun protection and stay hydrated!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨，体感 28℃，湿度 92%。外出带伞，小心路滑，保持好心情。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has light rain, feels like 28°C with 92% humidity. Take an umbrella, watch for slippery roads, and stay cheerful.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 34℃ 且无风。多云闷热，避免户外久留，小心中暑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 34°C with no wind. It's cloudy and muggy, avoid prolonged outdoor stays to prevent heatstroke.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 33℃，风力 4 级。记得带伞，风大注意安全哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 33°C with a 4-level wind. Remember your umbrella, and stay safe in the wind.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃。湿度较高，穿衣以舒适透气为主哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 30°C. With high humidity, choose comfortable, breathable clothes.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 29℃，风力 4 级。户外活动注意防风和湿度哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 29°C with a 4-level wind. For outdoor activities, mind the wind and humidity.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 33℃，湿度 89%。多云闷热，记得多喝水，避免长时间户外。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 33°C with 89% humidity. It's cloudy and muggy, remember to hydrate and avoid long outdoor exposure.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 33℃，多云天，注意防晒防暑，多补充水分哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels like 33°C, cloudy. Remember sun protection, prevent heatstroke, and drink more water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 33℃。天气闷热，请注意防暑降温，多喝水。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 33°C. It's muggy, please take precautions against heatstroke and stay hydrated.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热，体感高达 35℃。紫外线强，防晒补水，注意防暑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot, feels up to 35°C. Strong UV, remember sun protection, hydration, and prevent heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 32℃。闷热感强，穿衣以轻薄透气为主哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 32°C. It's very muggy, choose light, breathable clothes.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，气温 24℃，湿度 77%。微凉舒适，注意保持心情愉悦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, 24°C with 77% humidity. Mild and comfortable, remember to stay cheerful.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 29℃。湿度较高，注意补水，保持清爽哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 29°C. With high humidity, remember to hydrate and stay refreshed.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 24℃。体感舒适，户外活动也要记得防晒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, 24°C. Feels comfortable, but remember sun protection for outdoor activities.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 28℃，湿度 96%。潮湿闷热，请注意室内除湿。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 28°C with 96% humidity. Humid and muggy, please dehumidify indoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 28℃。湿度 86%，穿衣以舒适透气为主哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 28°C with 86% humidity. Choose comfortable, breathable clothes.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 28℃。湿度 83%，户外活动记得带伞，防范阵雨。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 28°C with 83% humidity. For outdoor activities, remember an umbrella and be ready for showers.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 93%。闷热潮湿，穿衣宜轻薄，注意防晒。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy, feels like 30°C with 93% humidity. Muggy and humid, wear light clothes and mind sun protection.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 99%。闷热感强，穿衣要轻薄透气哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 30°C with 99% humidity. It's muggy, wear light, breathable clothes.
